environment.description: Ktor service deployed on ECS Fargate behind an ALB with AWS WAF v2 WebACL attached. The WebACL includes the managed rule group `AWS-AWSManagedRulesSQLiRuleSet` with action override set to COUNT on `SizeRestrictions_QUERYSTRING` but BLOCK on all SQLi detection rules. Additionally, pgBouncer is configured with `disable_prepared_statements = true` which forces all queries through pgBouncer's simple query protocol parser that rejects multi-statement queries. The pgBouncer `server_query_parsing` is set to `full` which validates query structure before forwarding. The ALB has a custom listener rule that drops requests where query string length exceeds 256 bytes.

config.load_balancer: AWS ALB with WAF v2 WebACL
waf_rules: Custom rule: query string byte length > 256 → BLOCK
config.db_permissions: SELECT on public.users only (via pg_hba + GRANT)
config.network: VPC with service in private subnet, ALB in public subnet
